title: Bollywood Stars With Foreign Passports, and Why OCI Is Not Citizenship
excerpt: Reports on Imran Khan's leave-India notice have refocused attention on Alia Bhatt, Katrina Kaif and others who hold foreign citizenship — and on what an OCI card does and does not give its holder.
body:
• Actor Imran Khan, a US citizen holding an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card, has been served a leave-India notice, according to Filmibeat and Northeast Herald reports — putting Bollywood's foreign-citizen stars back in focus.
  • Two independent reports agree that Alia Bhatt and Katrina Kaif hold British citizenship, Nora Fatehi holds Canadian, Jacqueline Fernandez holds Sri Lankan, Kalki Koechlin holds French, and Sunny Leone and Nargis Fakhri hold North American citizenship.
  • India does not permit dual citizenship, and an OCI card is not Indian citizenship — it gives lifelong visa privileges but no vote and no Indian passport.
  • Akshay Kumar is the exception that proves the rule: he held Canadian citizenship until he publicly received Indian citizenship on August 15, 2023, and should no longer be listed as a foreign-passport holder.

A notice served on one actor has reopened a question Bollywood fans ask every few years: how many of the industry's biggest names are not Indian citizens at all? According to Filmibeat, Imran Khan — born in Madison, Wisconsin, and a United States citizen — was served a 'Leave India' notice after taking part in a protest in Mumbai, and holds an Overseas Citizen of India card rather than Indian citizenship. Northeast Herald, reporting the same development, said the Foreigners Regional Registration Office cited his American citizenship and OCI status.

The reports differ in details attributed to authorities, and The Videshi has not independently seen the notice. What both establish is the underlying status — and it is not unusual in Hindi cinema.

The Names Both Reports Agree On

Cross-checking the two lists, the consistent names are these. Alia Bhatt, born and raised in Mumbai, holds British citizenship through her mother Soni Razdan, who was born in Birmingham, England. Katrina Kaif, born in Hong Kong to a British mother, also holds British citizenship, despite more than two decades as one of Hindi cinema's leading stars.

Nora Fatehi, born and raised in Toronto to Moroccan parents, holds Canadian citizenship. Jacqueline Fernandez holds Sri Lankan citizenship and entered entertainment after winning Miss Universe Sri Lanka in 2006, before building a Bollywood career with films such as Murder 2, Kick and Housefull 2. Kalki Koechlin, born in Puducherry to French parents, holds French citizenship while working mainly in Indian cinema, from Dev.D to Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara.

Sunny Leone, born in Canada, holds Canadian and American citizenship, according to both reports. Nargis Fakhri, born in Queens, New York, holds American citizenship and debuted opposite Ranbir Kapoor in Rockstar. Northeast Herald also reports Ileana D'Cruz as holding Portuguese citizenship; Filmibeat does not include her, so that is single-source.

Why This Is Not Just Trivia

India does not allow dual citizenship. A person who takes another country's passport does not keep an Indian one, and an OCI card — the status held by many diaspora Indians and, on these reports, by Imran Khan — is a lifelong visa and residency privilege, not citizenship. As Northeast Herald put it, foreign citizenship and OCI status are distinct, and an OCI card does not confer Indian citizenship.

That distinction has practical consequences. An OCI holder can live and work in India without a separate visa, but cannot vote, cannot hold an Indian passport, and remains a foreign national in Indian law — which is why an FRRO notice is legally possible at all. Some of Bollywood's most bankable faces reside in India under the same framework that governs an NRI returning from Toronto or New Jersey.

The Akshay Kumar Correction

Older versions of this listicle, still circulating online, almost always lead with Akshay Kumar and Canadian citizenship. That is now out of date, and both current reports correct it. Filmibeat noted he held Canadian citizenship before officially regaining Indian citizenship on Independence Day, August 15, 2023. Northeast Herald made the same point explicitly: he should not be included among actors who currently hold only foreign citizenship.

Birthplace alone proves nothing, so this article sticks to names on which two current reports agree, and flags the one single-source entry as reported rather than confirmed.

What It Means for Diaspora Readers

For audiences abroad, this is familiar territory. Millions of diaspora families hold the same mix — a foreign passport, an OCI card, and a home that is unmistakably Indian. If you are an OCI holder on an extended stay in India, keep your FRRO registration and OCI documentation current: OCI status, however permanent it feels, is not citizenship.

What to Watch Next

Watch for an official statement on Imran Khan's notice. Until then, the verified part is the list itself — and the reminder that in Bollywood, as in the diaspora, identity and passport are not the same thing.
